Aug. 22 Thanks - V. Sister M. Honorata 85 of Astoria L.I. - several years afflicted with distructive arthritis - 8 mo. in hospital when her sister enrolled her in Ser. Masses. Drs said she'd never walk a- gain. She celebrated her golden jubilee recently and having dis- carded her crutches walks perfectly. Deo Gratias
V.V. Sisters of St. Dominic - Farmington has no chapel - has to go a mile to church - have only room for half the Catholic Child - ren ...
25 Frank Piper - 48 - threatened with lung trouble.
Tho's Hyland- 62 - Pittsburgh - gangreen.
Page 94 Aug. 25 Edw'd Gebhardt - 55 - intestinal cancer, unless a miracle ... hopeless - Episcopelian himself, his Catholic wife hopes for such .... has been enrolled a member of living in S.M.A.
28 Joseph Rassey - 24 - severe pains in back and stomach - day and night for two weeks ..
Mrs. Theodore DeLor - 62 - dislocation of hip five yrs. ago - of late it seems to be like arthritis.
Augusta Bourassa -- 61 - Wyandotte
Henry Kubitski - 21 - only help for invalid father T.B. and mother not well - They ask for prayers that he be deferred.
29 Ronald Kennedy - 14 - pneumonia, apendicitis, and stone in kidney. Enrolled % phone 2:30 P.M. by neighbor O'Malley.
Mareen Narditch again ( last week) improving remarkably able to talk again and paralysis leaving the hands.
Page 95 Aug. 30
Baby Dennis M. Kennedy - 18 mo. - has lost its hearing. . Frank Rubitt - 60 - trouble with heart for several years. Now some- thing like arthritis.
Eliz Campeau - 56 of Cleveland - intestinal obstruction.
Mrs. Helen L. Whitwell - 53 - lost hearing two weeks ago.
